title: Reflexives 2
note: The half a2_reflexives handed forward in writing. A2 kept only the interference core (*I feel myself good, *It happened me). This unit is by myself / on my own for alone, and the emphatic I did it myself. Third job: each other vs themselves, where Czech se / si covers both. Thickened 10 -> 25 items 2026-09-04 (agent loop): 15 new across the three jobs the unit exists for - by myself / on my own for alone, the emphatic -self at the end, and each other vs -selves, which Czech se/si does not separate. All persons are drilled, and the reflexive after a preposition (cook for themselves, play with each other) is in the bank now. Rules applied this pass: A4 both cleared (the Czech demonstrative on `ten byt`, and The children -> Our children); F3 painted / shed / looked swapped for taught verbs - `looked after` also had to go for F2, since phrasal verbs are taught nine slots later at b1_phrasal_verbs. Option lists carry this unit's own errors: by my own, theirselves, ourself, and each other vs themselves in both directions.

cards.title: By myself
points: Czech **sám** covers both jobs. English splits them by position.

cards.title: The -self words
points: You already know these words. These words do two more jobs besides the plain one.

cards.title: Alone, or without help?
points: **by** + self is about company. Self on its own is about who did the work.

rows: I went to the cinema **by myself**.
somebody could have helped, but I did it

cards.title: each other
points: Czech **si** covers both, so this pair has to be learned by meaning.

rows: A helped B and B helped A

cards.title: Common mistakes
points: **by myself** or **on my** own — never *by my own*.

rows: ~~She painted the room by herself alone.~~

items.en: I live by myself.
accepts: I live by myself.
I live on my own.
items.explanation: **by myself** = alone. With **on** you would need *on my own*.
items.explanation_cz: **by myself** = sám. S **on** by to bylo *on my own*.

items.en: She cleaned the flat herself.
accepts: She cleaned the flat herself.
items.explanation: **herself** at the end means she did the work, with no help.
items.explanation_cz: **herself** na konci znamená, že to udělala sama, bez pomoci.
items.wrong: She cleaned the flat by her own.

items.en: They helped each other.
accepts: They helped each other.
items.explanation: **each other** = A to B and B to A. themselves would mean each helped himself.
items.explanation_cz: **each other** = A B a B A. themselves by znamenalo, že každý pomohl sám sobě.

items.en: I did it on my own.
items.gap: I did it ____ my own. (on / by)
accepts: I did it on my own.
items.wrong: I did it by my own.
items.explanation: The set phrase is **on my own**, never *by my own*.
items.explanation_cz: Ustálená fráze je **on my own**, nikdy *by my own*.

items.en: He went to Prague by himself.
items.gap: He went to Prague ____ himself. (by / on)
accepts: He went to Prague by himself.
items.explanation: **by himself** — nobody travelled with him.
items.explanation_cz: **by himself** — nikdo s ním necestoval.

items.en: We cooked dinner ourselves.
accepts: We cooked dinner ourselves.
items.explanation: Plural **we** takes **ourselves**, at the end for emphasis.
items.explanation_cz: Množné **we** má **ourselves**, na konci pro zdůraznění.

items.en: Our children can cook for themselves.
items.cz: Naše děti si umí uvařit samy.
accepts: Our children can cook for themselves.
items.explanation: Each child cooks for **himself**, so it is **themselves**. *each other* would mean they cook for one another.
items.explanation_cz: Každé dítě vaří **sobě**, takže **themselves**. *each other* by znamenalo, že vaří jedno druhému.
items.wrong: Our children can cook for each other.

items.en: Do you want to go by yourself?
items.gap: Do you want to go ____ yourself? (by / on)
accepts: Do you want to go by yourself?
items.explanation: **by yourself** asks about going alone.
items.explanation_cz: **by yourself** se ptá na to, jestli jdeš sám.

items.en: My parents write to each other every week.
items.gap: My parents write to ____ every week. (each / them)
accepts: My parents write to each other every week.
items.explanation: Two people writing in both directions: **each other**.
items.explanation_cz: Dva lidé si píší oběma směry: **each other**.

items.en: I made this cake myself.
accepts: I made this cake myself.
items.explanation: **myself** at the end stresses who did it.
items.explanation_cz: **myself** na konci zdůrazňuje, kdo to udělal.

items.en: He lives on his own now.
items.gap: He lives ____ his own now. (on / by)
accepts: He lives on his own now.
items.wrong: He lives by his own now.
items.explanation: **on** + his own is the twin of *by himself*. Never *by his own*.
items.explanation_cz: **on** + his own je dvojče k *by himself*. Nikdy *by his own*.

items.en: Did you write this yourself?
accepts: Did you write this yourself?
items.wrong: Did you write this by your own?
items.explanation: End position, so it is the emphatic one: nobody helped you. **yourself** for one person.
items.explanation_cz: Na konci věty je to zdůraznění: nikdo ti nepomohl. **yourself** pro jednu osobu.

items.en: We drove there by ourselves.
accepts: We drove there by ourselves.
items.explanation: **by** + ourselves means nobody was with us.
items.explanation_cz: **by** + ourselves znamená, že s námi nikdo nebyl.

items.en: They talk to each other every day.
items.gap: They talk to ____ every day. (each / them)
accepts: They talk to each other every day.
items.wrong: They talk to themselves every day.
items.explanation: A talks to B and B talks to A: **each other**. *themselves* would mean each one talks alone.
items.explanation_cz: A mluví s B a B s A: **each other**. *themselves* by znamenalo, že si každý povídá sám pro sebe.

items.en: My sister and I help each other a lot.
items.gap: My sister and I help ____ a lot. (each / us)
accepts: My sister and I help each other a lot.
items.wrong: My sister and I help ourselves a lot.
items.explanation: Two people helping in both directions is **each other**.
items.explanation_cz: Dva lidé, kteří si pomáhají navzájem, mají **each other**.

items.en: She works better by herself.
accepts: She works better by herself.
items.explanation: **by herself** = alone. *on herself* is not the phrase; the *on* one is **on her own**.
items.explanation_cz: **by herself** = sama. *on herself* není vazba; s *on* je to **on her own**.

items.en: The teacher wrote the test herself.
items.cz: Ta učitelka ten test napsala sama.
accepts: The teacher wrote the test herself.
items.wrong: The teacher wrote the test by her own.
items.explanation: Emphatic at the end: she wrote it, not somebody else. **herself**.
items.explanation_cz: Zdůraznění na konci: napsala ho ona, ne někdo jiný. **herself**.

items.en: They bought the tickets themselves.
accepts: They bought the tickets themselves.
items.explanation: There is no *theirselves*. The form is **themselves**.
items.explanation_cz: Žádné *theirselves* neexistuje. Tvar je **themselves**.

items.en: We do not know each other very well.
items.gap: We do not know ____ very well. (each / us)
accepts: We do not know each other very well.
We don't know each other very well.
items.wrong: We do not know ourselves very well.
items.explanation: You know him and he knows you: **each other**.
items.explanation_cz: Ty znáš jeho a on tebe: **each other**.

items.en: He always travels on his own.
items.gap: He always travels ____ his own. (on / by)
accepts: He always travels on his own.
items.wrong: He always travels by his own.
items.explanation: **on** + his own is the twin of *by himself*. Never *by his own*.
items.explanation_cz: **on** + his own je dvojče k *by himself*. Nikdy *by his own*.

items.en: Our children play with each other after school.
items.cz: Naše děti si po škole hrají spolu.
items.gap: Our children play with ____ after school. (each / them)
accepts: Our children play with each other after school.
items.wrong: Our children play with themselves after school.
items.explanation: They play together, so **each other**. *with themselves* says each child plays alone.
items.explanation_cz: Hrají si spolu, takže **each other**. *with themselves* říká, že si každé hraje samo.

items.en: I told him myself.
accepts: I told him myself.
items.wrong: I told him by my own.
items.explanation: **myself** at the end: I did the telling, nobody passed the message on.
items.explanation_cz: **myself** na konci: řekl jsem mu to já, nikdo to nevyřizoval.

items.en: She lives on her own in a small flat.
items.gap: She lives ____ her own in a small flat. (on / by)
accepts: She lives on her own in a small flat.
items.wrong: She lives by her own in a small flat.
items.explanation: **on** + his own is the twin of *by himself*. Never *by his own*.
items.explanation_cz: **on** + his own je dvojče k *by himself*. Nikdy *by his own*.

items.en: I cut my hair myself.
accepts: I cut my hair myself.
items.wrong: I cut my hair by my own.
items.explanation: Nobody cuts it for me, so the emphatic **myself** goes at the end.
items.explanation_cz: Nikdo mi je nestříhá, takže na konec patří zdůrazňující **myself**.

items.en: Do you want to live by yourself?
items.gap: Do you want to live ____ yourself? (by / on)
accepts: Do you want to live by yourself?
items.wrong: Do you want to live on yourself?
items.explanation: **by yourself** = with nobody else. The *on* version is **on your own**.
items.explanation_cz: **by yourself** = bez nikoho dalšího. Verze s *on* je **on your own**.
